title.narrative: Strengthening capacities of national institutions in Ecuador in identifying and managing cultural and natural heritage.

description.narrative:
In close cooperation with the national authorities of Ecuador, in particular the Ministry of Education, Sports and Culture, the National Institute for Cultural Heritage (INPC), and the Ministry of Environment and Energy, a series of training activities and technical assistance will be conducted on the implementation of the 1972 World Heritage Convention to enhance local strategies to support the protection and preservation of cultural and natural heritage:
-Training workshops with the participation of the Decentralized Autonomous Governments of Ecuador (regional, provincial, and cantonal GADs) to propose, design and strengthen management plans for cultural, natural and mixed World Heritage properties, and those that have the potential to be inscribed on the World Heritage List. -Technical assistance to build dossiers of nominations for the World Heritage List, based on prioritized sites currently on the Tentative List. -Technical assistance to purge the current Tentative List, by guiding the State Party on how to assess the elements that may have lost their OUV, or that are not relevant for the State Party.
